title: Building Resilience in Graduate School and Beyond
description: Additional information: The class will meet synchronously/virtually via zoom Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays during winter term. Class time will include brief lectures, whole class discussions, and time in breakout rooms for smaller discussions and group work time. Outside of class time, students are expected to complete a small number of readings, a variety of self-assessments, and to reflect on the materials in discussion posts or reflective writing.
